summary: Tested Audio Studio timeline synchronization rewrite. Key findings: Zoom functionality WORKING correctly (clip positions scale with zoom while preserving time), Click-to-seek WORKING (visually correct, debug needs update fix), Debug overlay partially working. Found 2 bugs requiring fixes.

ui_bugs.issue: Debug overlay does not update Timeline Time and Playhead Px after seeking - only Last Click updates. updateDebugInfo() is not called in seekToTime()
ui_bugs.fix_location: Line 364-384: seekToTime function should call updateDebugInfo after setting timelineTime

ui_bugs.issue: AudioContext gets closed and is never recreated. ensureAudioContext() only checks for 'suspended' state, not 'closed'. When context is closed, audio playback fails with 'Construction of AudioBufferSourceNode is not useful when context is closed'
ui_bugs.fix_location: Line 134-139: ensureAudioContext should check for 'closed' state and create a new AudioContext if needed

timeline_synchronization.details: Playhead visually moves correctly when clicking timeline. Transport display (00:10.000) shows correct time. Playhead position matches clicked location.

click_to_seek.details: Click at 10s correctly moves playhead to 10-second mark. Visual position correct. Debug overlay shows correct Last Click (10.000s) but Timeline Time stays at 0.000s until playback starts.

zoom_functionality.details: Zoom from 1x to 2x correctly doubles pixel positions (250px -> 500px). pixelsPerSecond updates correctly (50.0 -> 100.0). Timeline width scales (3000px -> 6000px). Clip positions return to original after zoom out.

playback_precision.details: Audio clips scheduled correctly ([Audio] Scheduled generated-1771319324351-458d16901: when=5.000, offset=0.000, duration=2.560) but AudioContext is 'closed' so no audio plays. Console errors: 'Construction of AudioBufferSourceNode is not useful when context is closed'

debug_overlay.details: Shows correct values during playback but not after seek. Shows: Timeline Time, Playhead Px, Pixels/Sec, Last Click, AudioContext state, AC Time, Active Clips, Zoom, Duration, Timeline Width

action_items: FIX CRITICAL: AudioContext recreation in ensureAudioContext() - check for 'closed' state and create new context: if (audioContextRef.current?.state === 'closed') { audioContextRef.current = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)(); }
FIX MEDIUM: Call updateDebugInfo() after setTimelineTime() in seekToTime() function to update debug overlay when seeking
CONSIDER: The useEffect cleanup at line 124-130 closes AudioContext on unmount - ensure it's properly recreated on component remount
critical_code_review_comments: ensureAudioContext (line 134-139) only handles 'suspended' state but not 'closed' - browser policies may close AudioContext and it needs recreation
seekToTime (line 364-384) updates timelineTime state but doesn't trigger debug overlay update - debug info only updates in playback loop
useEffect at line 118-131 has missing dependency 'stopPlayback' as flagged by ESLint

success_rate.frontend: 60% - Core timeline/zoom working, audio playback broken due to AudioContext issue
